value.text: Tenofovir once daily for hepatitis B and metformin twice daily for diabetes. No blood thinners and no regular painkillers.

release_text: Tenofovir once daily for hepatitis B and metformin twice daily for diabetes. No blood thinners and no regular painkillers.
lay_text: I take tenofovir for my hepatitis B, once a day, and metformin tablets for my sugar. Nothing to thin the blood, and no regular painkillers.
rationale: Tenofovir is in the article (H02). The diabetes treatment is not reported: metformin is the likeliest first-line drug for type 2 diabetes. Consistent with H10 (no anticoagulant).

value.text: Takes tenofovir every day; often forgets or skips his metformin.

release_text: Takes tenofovir every day; often forgets or skips his metformin.
lay_text: I never miss the hepatitis tablet. The diabetes tablets I forget quite a lot, to be honest.
rationale: The article says the diabetes is poorly controlled; poor adherence is the commonest reason. Suppressed hepatitis B (G05) fits regular tenofovir.

lay_text: No, I don't buy anything from the chemist, not even painkillers.
rationale: No aspirin or NSAID is mentioned; bleeding tendency is fully explained by the factor pattern.

value.text: Tranexamic acid tablets for two days, prescribed by his dentist; no other new medicines.

release_text: Tranexamic acid tablets for two days, prescribed by his dentist; no other new medicines.
lay_text: The dentist gave me some tablets to stop the bleeding, for two days. Nothing else new.
rationale: From H05 (oral tranexamic acid for two days). Worded as a medicine change only.

value.text: No supplements, herbal or traditional remedies.

release_text: No supplements, herbal or traditional remedies.
lay_text: No, I don't take any supplements or herbal medicines.
rationale: Not reported; the authors list every exposure they considered and none is a remedy.

value.text: No antibiotics in the past three months.

release_text: No antibiotics in the past three months.
lay_text: No antibiotics recently.
rationale: Not reported; no infection (H07). Keeps antibiotic-related vitamin K deficiency off the table, as the authors did.

value.text: Lives in a rented apartment with his sister; no renovation; no pest control in the home.

release_text: Lives in a rented apartment with his sister; no renovation; no pest control in the home.
lay_text: We rent an apartment, my sister and me. Nothing's been done to it and we've never had pest control in.
rationale: Article: no rodent infestation at home (H18). Answers the home-environment question only.

value.text: More tired than usual for the past week or two.

release_text: More tired than usual for the past week or two.
lay_text: I've been more tired than normal the last week or two.
rationale: Haemoglobin 72 g/L after two weeks of bleeding: tiredness is the expected symptom.

value.text: Short of breath climbing stairs over the past week; not breathless at rest.

release_text: Short of breath climbing stairs over the past week; not breathless at rest.
lay_text: I get out of breath going up the stairs this last week. I'm fine sitting down.
rationale: Anaemia of 72 g/L developing over two weeks; exertional breathlessness is likely.

value.text: No blackouts or fainting; occasionally light-headed on standing up quickly.

release_text: No blackouts or fainting; occasionally light-headed on standing up quickly.
lay_text: I haven't fainted. Sometimes I feel a bit light-headed if I stand up fast.
rationale: Blood pressure 106/71 with haemoglobin 72 g/L: mild orthostatic symptoms are likely; no syncope reported.

value.text: Brief light-headedness on standing quickly; no vertigo or unsteadiness.

release_text: Brief light-headedness on standing quickly; no vertigo or unsteadiness.
lay_text: Just a bit light-headed if I get up too quickly. The room doesn't spin.
rationale: Consistent with the syncope answer and the anaemia.

value.text: Still working in the kitchen, but tired, and embarrassed by the bleeding at work.

release_text: Still working in the kitchen, but tired, and embarrassed by the bleeding at work.
lay_text: I'm still working, but I'm tired, and it's embarrassing bleeding from the mouth in the kitchen.
rationale: Works as a chef (H14); tired from the anaemia.

value.text: Gum bleeding worse after brushing his teeth and eating; pressing on the nose stops the nosebleeds for a while.

release_text: Gum bleeding worse after brushing his teeth and eating; pressing on the nose stops the nosebleeds for a while.
lay_text: The gums bleed more after I brush or eat. If I pinch my nose it stops for a bit.
rationale: Typical of mucosal bleeding from a coagulation defect; not reported.

value.text: No pain; some discomfort passing small clots in the urine.

release_text: No pain; some discomfort passing small clots in the urine.
lay_text: No real pain. It's a bit uncomfortable when small clots come out when I pee.
rationale: Visible haematuria with a severe coagulopathy often passes clots; no loin or abdominal pain is reported.

lay_text: I've never had a blood transfusion.
rationale: Male patient; no previous bleeding problems (H09). The pregnancy part of the template does not apply.

value.text: Has not noticed yellowing of his eyes or skin.

release_text: Has not noticed yellowing of his eyes or skin.
lay_text: No, my eyes and skin haven't gone yellow.
rationale: Chronic hepatitis B suppressed on tenofovir (G05); bilirubin normal.

lay_text: No, my tummy isn't swollen.
rationale: No cirrhosis or ascites (G05).

value.text: Has spat out blood from his mouth; has not vomited blood; stools a normal brown colour, never black or bloody.

release_text: Has spat out blood from his mouth; has not vomited blood; stools a normal brown colour, never black or bloody.
lay_text: I spit out blood from my mouth, but I haven't vomited blood. My stools look normal, not black and no blood.
rationale: The endoscopy found no upper GI bleeding and the blood came from the mouth (H06). The authors report no melaena; swallowed blood from the gums was probably why an upper GI source was suspected.

value.text: No burning on passing urine; mild discomfort when small clots pass.

release_text: No burning on passing urine; mild discomfort when small clots pass.
lay_text: It doesn't burn. Only a bit uncomfortable when a small clot comes out.
rationale: Consistent with the pain answer; no infection (sterile urine, G09).

value.text: Gets up once or twice a night to pass urine for some months; no urgency.

release_text: Gets up once or twice a night to pass urine for some months; no urgency.
lay_text: I get up once or twice at night to pee, for a few months now. I don't have to rush.
rationale: Poorly controlled diabetes with glycosuria: mild nocturia is likely.

value.text: Often thirsty and drinks a lot of water, especially in the hot kitchen.

release_text: Often thirsty and drinks a lot of water, especially in the hot kitchen.
lay_text: I'm thirsty a lot and drink plenty of water, especially at work in the hot kitchen.
rationale: Random glucose around 13 mmol/L with glycosuria (G04).

value.text: Bowels open daily; no diarrhoea; stools not pale or greasy.

release_text: Bowels open daily; no diarrhoea; stools not pale or greasy.
lay_text: I go every day, normal. No diarrhoea and nothing greasy.
rationale: No malabsorption: faecal elastase and coeliac serology normal; the authors found no gastrointestinal cause.

value.text: No fever or night sweats; weight steady.

release_text: No fever or night sweats; weight steady.
lay_text: No fevers or sweats, and my weight's the same.
rationale: Afebrile (36.6 °C, E02); no infection (H07).

value.text: Appetite normal; no nausea or vomiting.

release_text: Appetite normal; no nausea or vomiting.
lay_text: I'm eating as normal. No sickness.
rationale: Not reported; nothing in the truth changes it.

value.text: Mood fine; worried about the bleeding, but still enjoys his work and life.

release_text: Mood fine; worried about the bleeding, but still enjoys his work and life.
lay_text: My mood's fine. I'm worried about this bleeding, but otherwise I'm OK.
rationale: The authors considered self-harm and set it aside; nothing suggests depression.

value.text: No thoughts of self-harm or suicide, now or before.

release_text: No thoughts of self-harm or suicide, now or before.
lay_text: No, never. I've never thought about hurting myself.
rationale: The authors weighed a suicide attempt and rejected it; the food source explains the poisoning.

value.text: No major stresses apart from the bleeding; gets on well with his sister.

release_text: No major stresses apart from the bleeding; gets on well with his sister.
lay_text: Nothing big, apart from worrying about this. My sister and I get on fine.
rationale: No reported conflict or stress; relevant to the intentional-poisoning alternative.

lay_text: No drugs, no. Not even cannabis.
rationale: Contaminated synthetic cannabinoids are a known source of the truth's poison; the article reports no drug use.

value.text: Worried about the bleeding and what is causing it; no anxiety beyond that.

release_text: Worried about the bleeding and what is causing it; no anxiety beyond that.
lay_text: I'm worried about all this bleeding and what's causing it. Otherwise I'm not an anxious person.
rationale: Consistent with his stated concern (H08); the template's 'no worry' would contradict it.

value.text: Passing a little more urine than usual; never less.

release_text: Passing a little more urine than usual; never less.
lay_text: I pee a bit more than I used to, not less.
rationale: Poorly controlled diabetes with glycosuria (G04); consistent with the thirst and nocturia answers.

lay_text: No rashes.
rationale: No features of lupus; family history only (H16).

value.text: No mouth ulcers; the bleeding comes from the gums.

release_text: No mouth ulcers; the bleeding comes from the gums.
lay_text: No ulcers. It's just the gums bleeding.
rationale: Consistent with H03.

lay_text: No headaches.
rationale: No intracranial bleeding reported; normal consciousness.

value.text: No pets and no contact with farm animals; handles raw meat and poultry at work as a chef.

release_text: No pets and no contact with farm animals; handles raw meat and poultry at work as a chef.
lay_text: No pets. I handle raw meat and chicken at work, being a chef.
rationale: Answers the contact question only (SPEC §6.4 rule 8). The market food is released by the food question (H19), as in the article.

lay_text: No bites or stings.
rationale: Not reported; no fever or rash.

value.text: Alert and comfortable at rest; looks pale.

release_text: Alert and comfortable at rest; looks pale.
rationale: Haemoglobin 72 g/L; stable vital signs (E02).

value.text: Pallor of the conjunctivae and palms.

release_text: Pallor of the conjunctivae and palms.
rationale: Haemoglobin 72 g/L.

value.text: Slow oozing of blood from the gum margins; gums not swollen or hypertrophied; no obvious dental abscess.

release_text: Slow oozing of blood from the gum margins; gums not swollen or hypertrophied; no obvious dental abscess.
rationale: History of gum bleeding (H03) and oozing from the mouth (E01). No local dental cause, since tranexamic acid failed and the bleeding stopped with vitamin K.

value.text: No petechiae. Small bruises around venepuncture sites in both antecubital fossae.

release_text: No petechiae. Small bruises around venepuncture sites in both antecubital fossae.
rationale: Platelets normal (226), so no petechiae. With an unmeasurable INR, bruising at venepuncture sites is likely; the article reports mucosal bleeding only, so no spontaneous ecchymoses are added.
Pulse 86/min from the article's vital signs (E02).

value.text: Lying 106/71 mmHg, pulse 86/min; standing (3 min) 98/66 mmHg, pulse 98/min, mildly light-headed.

release_text: Lying 106/71 mmHg, pulse 86/min; standing (3 min) 98/66 mmHg, pulse 98/min, mildly light-headed.
rationale: Lying values from E02. Haemoglobin 72 g/L after two weeks of bleeding: a small postural drop below the 20 mmHg threshold is likely.
No liver failure (G05).

value.text: No palmar erythema, leukonychia or clubbing; no flapping tremor.

release_text: No palmar erythema, leukonychia or clubbing; no flapping tremor.
rationale: No stigmata of chronic liver disease (G05).
No cirrhosis or portal hypertension (G05).

value.text: Percussion note tympanic; no shifting dullness.

release_text: Percussion note tympanic; no shifting dullness.
rationale: No ascites (G05).

value.text: No spider naevi, jaundice or rash; bruising only as noted at venepuncture sites.

release_text: No spider naevi, jaundice or rash; bruising only as noted at venepuncture sites.
rationale: No stigmata of chronic liver disease (G05); consistent with the purpura examination.

value.text: No tremor, asterixis or other involuntary movements.

release_text: No tremor, asterixis or other involuntary movements.
rationale: No hepatic encephalopathy.

value.text: Normal perianal skin; no rectal mass; brown stool on the glove with no blood or melaena.

release_text: Normal perianal skin; no rectal mass; brown stool on the glove with no blood or melaena.
rationale: No lower GI bleeding reported; consistent with the negative FIT.
Haematuria from the coagulopathy, not a renal lesion (G09).
Normal renal ultrasound (G09).

value.text: No joint swelling, warmth or restricted movement.

release_text: No joint swelling, warmth or restricted movement.
rationale: No haemarthrosis; no previous joint bleeds (H09).
Poorly controlled diabetes (H02); matches the random plasma glucose.

value.text: Height 170 cm; weight 76 kg; BMI 26.3 kg/m2.

release_text: Height 170 cm; weight 76 kg; BMI 26.3 kg/m2.
rationale: Not reported. A mildly overweight BMI is typical of type 2 diabetes in a man of this age.

value.text: Alert and oriented to time, place and person; GCS 15/15.

release_text: Alert and oriented to time, place and person; GCS 15/15.
rationale: No intracranial bleeding; he gave a detailed history.

value.text: Optic discs pink with sharp margins; no retinal haemorrhages or exudates.

release_text: Optic discs pink with sharp margins; no retinal haemorrhages or exudates.
rationale: No bleeding beyond the mucosae and urine; retinopathy not reported.
